title: Nanovesicles Extraction Protocol
author: Veerle Baekelandt
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bw5wpg7e

steps.title: Prepare Exosome Depleted FBS
steps.instruction: Prepare exosome depleted FBS by filtering commercial FBS through a 0.22 µm filter and centrifuging at 140,000 x g overnight.

steps.title: Seed Cells
steps.instruction: Seed cells in 3 x 15 cm dishes at a density of 20 x 10^6 cells per plate and incubate for 24 hours.

steps.title: Wash Cells
steps.instruction: Wash the cells in all plates twice with 10 mL of 1x PBS.

steps.title: Incubate Cells in Depleted Medium
steps.instruction: Add 10 mL of DMEM containing 1% exosome depleted FBS to each plate and incubate for 24 hours.

steps.title: Purify Nanovesicles via Differential Centrifugation
steps.instruction: Collect the medium and purify the nanovesicles using a differential centrifugation sequence.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 15,000 x g for 30 minutes to remove cell debris.
Filter the resulting supernatant through a 0.22 µm filter to remove apoptotic bodies.

steps.title: Collect Nanovesicles
steps.instruction: Decant the supernatant and collect the nanovesicles in the appropriate buffer based on the downstream application.

substeps.instruction: Use 50 µL cell lysis buffer for western blotting.
Use 50 µL PBS + PI for intact cell cross-linking.
